title: Add durable command lifecycle projection foundation
description: Expose durable command-state changes for independent projections without coupling worker execution to dashboard writes. Add reusable state-change contract, stream support and least-privilege access where appropriate, with focused validation. Keep client configuration and dashboard-specific credentials outside this task.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented the durable lifecycle projection foundation. CommandServiceStateStack now enables NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES on the command-state table, publishes its stream ARN, and exposes a least-privilege stream-read grant for independent projectors. The table, queues, and existing logical IDs remain unchanged. Validation: python -m pytest infrastructure/tests/unit/test_command_service_state_stack.py infrastructure/tests/unit/test_command_service_worker_stack.py -q (44 passed); ruff and black checks; git diff --check; rcql -q --lang=python --scan-files ./plexus/infrastructure/command_service/state_stack.py --no-fail (0 findings).
